description: Source-backed contract for FOnline audio baking, runtime decoding, playback handles, placement, mixing, script entry points, and validation boundaries.

scope.support_note: Authored WAV and native Ogg inputs, the baked Ogg payload, sound handles, placement updates, and client playback behavior are revision-pinned by focused baker and mixer tests.
included: WAV authoring and Ogg Vorbis native resource inputs accepted by AudioBaker
AudioBaker delivery and AudioManager resource-path indexing
AudioManager decoding, conversion, streaming, mixing, placement, repeat, and stop behavior
Game.PlaySound, Game.UpdateSound, and Game.PlayMusic client script entry points
Audio settings, headless behavior, diagnostics, and project validation boundaries
excluded: project sound catalogs, concept-to-path mappings, variant selection, music state machines, ambient selection, and spatialization policy
recording, voice chat, capture devices, DSP graphs, buses, ducking, and authored attenuation curves
audio mastering targets, loudness policy, licensing, attribution, and source provenance
Effekseer sound nodes, which are not supported by the FOnline Effekseer runtime

formats.name: PCM WAV
formats.role: Authoring input converted to the runtime Ogg Vorbis payload
formats.requirement: Use RIFF/WAVE PCM at 8, 16, 24, or 32 bits, or IEEE float at 32 bits; chunks may appear in any order and unknown chunks are skipped with RIFF padding respected.
formats.rationale: AudioBaker normalizes supported WAV samples to interleaved signed 16-bit PCM and encodes one checked Ogg Vorbis resource at the authored path.

formats.name: Ogg Vorbis
formats.role: Native runtime payload and lossless passthrough authoring input
formats.requirement: Use an Ogg bitstream containing Vorbis audio; AudioBaker verifies and copies an authored .ogg without lossy re-encoding, and AudioManager streams every baked audio resource through libvorbisfile.
formats.rationale: Every runtime payload is Vorbis even when its preserved authored path ends in .wav, so runtime dispatch never trusts the suffix as a codec declaration.

delivery_rules.name: AudioBaker delivery
delivery_rules.requirement: Include the Audio baker in each resource pack that owns runtime audio; it accepts the configured wav and ogg inputs and writes a verified Ogg Vorbis payload.
delivery_rules.rationale: Audio resources no longer use RawCopy: WAV is normalized and encoded while an already-native Ogg is verified and copied without another lossy pass.

delivery_rules.name: Client sound index
delivery_rules.requirement: Call AudioManager.IndexFiles after client resources are available; it records every path whose suffix occurs in Audio.SoundFileExtensions.
delivery_rules.rationale: The manager exposes this source-backed path catalog, while Game.PlaySound itself receives the exact selected resource path and performs no concept or variant resolution.

delivery_rules.name: Exact authored path identity
delivery_rules.requirement: Pass the exact baked resource path, including its authored extension, to Game.PlaySound and Game.PlayMusic.
delivery_rules.rationale: AudioBaker preserves the authored path while replacing WAV bytes with Vorbis, and AudioManager reads that path directly without lowercasing or replacing the extension.

delivery_rules.name: Source extension and payload separation
delivery_rules.requirement: Treat a .wav suffix in baked resources as source identity, not runtime codec identity; all runtime bytes are Ogg Vorbis and .ogg sources remain .ogg.
delivery_rules.rationale: Preserving authored paths avoids rewriting project references while one runtime decoder and one package payload format remove platform-dependent format behavior.

anchors: Every audio resource the runtime plays is Ogg Vorbis

delivery_rules.name: Music path ownership
delivery_rules.requirement: Pass music as an exact resource path; unlike effects, music is not resolved through the normalized sound-name index.
delivery_rules.rationale: PlayMusic forwards the supplied filename directly to AudioManager.Load.

decoding_rules.name: WAV chunk order
decoding_rules.requirement: Provide RIFF/WAVE with one usable fmt chunk and a non-empty data chunk; AudioBaker walks chunks in any order, skips unknown chunks, and respects odd-byte padding.
decoding_rules.rationale: Real exports commonly insert metadata chunks or reorder fmt and data, so the baker validates chunk bounds instead of prescribing a narrow sequence.

decoding_rules.name: WAV PCM widths
decoding_rules.requirement: Author WAV as PCM at 8, 16, 24, or 32 bits or IEEE float at 32 bits; channel count and sample rate must be positive and block alignment must match the declared frame shape.
decoding_rules.rationale: AudioBaker converts each supported sample to signed 16-bit before Vorbis encoding and rejects truncated frames or inconsistent format metadata.

decoding_rules.name: Baked payload verification
decoding_rules.requirement: Reject a generated or passthrough payload unless libvorbisfile opens it as a valid Vorbis stream.
decoding_rules.rationale: The bake boundary catches malformed native input and encoder output before the client attempts playback; runtime then reads channel and sample-rate metadata from the verified stream.

decoding_rules.name: Ogg streaming
decoding_rules.requirement: Expect Ogg Vorbis to decode in 64 KiB native chunks and 128 KiB Web chunks; short files are retained fully and release the stream after the initial decode.
decoding_rules.rationale: AudioManager uses a platform-sized streaming portion and clears OggStream when the first read reaches EOF.

decoding_rules.name: Device conversion
decoding_rules.requirement: Let AppAudio convert decoded sample format, channel count, and rate to the active SDL output-device format before playback.
decoding_rules.rationale: AudioManager does not require authored assets to match one fixed hardware format.

decoding_rules.name: Audio callback mixing
decoding_rules.requirement: Treat playback as client audio-callback work; mutations of the active sound list must hold the audio-device lock.
decoding_rules.rationale: The SDL stream callback asks AudioManager to fill output while game-thread play/stop/update operations can add, mutate, or erase sounds.

decoding_rules.name: Single runtime decoder
decoding_rules.requirement: Route authored audio through AudioBaker and let AudioManager decode every resulting resource as Ogg Vorbis regardless of its preserved source suffix.
decoding_rules.rationale: Unsupported source extensions never enter the Audio baker, and runtime has no suffix dispatch that could silently accept an empty or differently encoded payload.

anchors: Every audio resource is baked to Ogg Vorbis

playback_rules.name: Game.PlaySound
playback_rules.requirement: Use Game.PlaySound on the client for non-music playback and retain its uint32 handle when the sound must be placed again; zero means no live sound was started.
playback_rules.rationale: The script method delegates the exact resource path to AudioManager and exposes the non-reused lifetime handle returned when the sound enters the mixer list.

playback_rules.name: Exact effect path
playback_rules.requirement: Resolve project concepts and numbered variants before Game.PlaySound, then pass the exact selected resource path including its authored suffix.
playback_rules.rationale: Variant policy belongs to the embedding project; AudioManager performs no stem normalization, suffix fallback, or catalog convention.

playback_rules.name: Placed sound start
playback_rules.requirement: Use the Game.PlaySound overload with attenuation and pan to start a placed sound; attenuation at or below zero returns handle zero before file I/O.
playback_rules.rationale: Placement is a caller-owned projection onto mixer attenuation and stereo balance, while distance curves and listener selection remain project policy.

anchors: Client_Game_PlaySound(ptr<ClientEngine> client, string_view soundName, float32_t attenuation, float32_t pan)
return Load(name, false, timespan::zero, attenuation, pan)

playback_rules.name: Placed sound update
playback_rules.requirement: Call Game.UpdateSound with a live handle to replace attenuation and pan as the source or listener moves; false means the handle is zero, audio is inactive, or playback already finished.
playback_rules.rationale: The update runs under the audio-device lock, so the mixer observes one placement pair and a completed sound cannot be revived through a stale handle.

playback_rules.name: Game.PlayMusic
playback_rules.requirement: Use Game.PlayMusic with an exact resource path and repeat interval; an empty path stops current music and succeeds.
playback_rules.rationale: The script entry point owns the empty-name stop convention before delegating to AudioManager.

playback_rules.name: Single music stream
playback_rules.requirement: Expect a new music request to stop every existing music instance before attempting to load the replacement.
playback_rules.rationale: AudioManager.PlayMusic calls StopMusic before Load, so a failed replacement does not restore the previous track.

playback_rules.name: Repeat interval
playback_rules.requirement: Pass a nonzero repeatTime to replay after completion; values at or below one millisecond repeat immediately, and larger values insert that delay.
playback_rules.rationale: ProcessSound schedules NextPlayTime using a one-millisecond threshold and rewinds retained Ogg streams before replay.

playback_rules.name: Sound and music volumes
playback_rules.requirement: Use Audio.SoundVolume and Audio.MusicVolume as startup defaults, then Game.SetSoundVolume and Game.SetMusicVolume for live changes; the frontend clamps each mix operation to 0 through 100.
playback_rules.rationale: AudioManager owns live volume state because Engine settings are immutable, selects it by IsMusic, and AppAudio normalizes the clamped percentage before SDL mixing.

playback_rules.name: Disabled audio return convention
playback_rules.requirement: Do not use PlayMusic true or a PlaySound handle as resource-existence proof when audio is disabled or unavailable; PlayMusic remains a successful no-op while PlaySound returns handle zero.
playback_rules.rationale: A disabled device is a normal player state, so music reports no refusal and effects report only that no live sound exists; baker validation owns resource correctness.

playback_rules.name: Stereo pan law
playback_rules.requirement: Pass pan in the range -1 through 1 for the stock balance law: negative attenuates the right channel, positive attenuates the left, and the near channel stays at unity.
playback_rules.rationale: AudioManager applies pan to the per-callback mix buffer rather than decoded storage, so later placement updates do not compound an earlier pan and loud samples are not boosted into clipping.

validation_rules.name: Source-backed reference
validation_rules.requirement: Regenerate and check the audio model whenever AudioBaker, AudioManager, AppAudio, settings, package delivery, or script entry points change.
validation_rules.rationale: The generated model rejects source-extension, runtime-codec, chunk-size, setting, handle, test-inventory, and headless drift before prose can silently become stale.

validation_rules.name: Audio baking gate
validation_rules.requirement: Bake representative PCM/float WAV and native Ogg inputs, verify authored paths are preserved, inspect the audio counters, and open every output as Vorbis.
validation_rules.rationale: Focused tests prove conversion and passthrough, while an embedding-project bake proves that its pack actually selects Audio and ships the resources consumed by its scripts.

validation_rules.name: Decoder diagnostics
validation_rules.requirement: Treat AudioBaker exceptions and Ogg open/decode/device-conversion diagnostics as authoring or packaging failures; do not bless a zero playback handle as content validation.
validation_rules.rationale: WAV and passthrough Ogg are rejected at bake time, while a resource that exists but cannot decode at runtime logs and enters the debugger instead of becoming silent success.

anchors: WAV encoding is not PCM or IEEE float
Ogg file is not a Vorbis stream

validation_rules.name: Headless boundary
validation_rules.requirement: Do not claim audible validation from a headless or stub application; AppAudio is disabled there and playback may report no-op success.
validation_rules.rationale: Headless audio deliberately exposes no active device or callback.

validation_rules.name: Focused native coverage
validation_rules.requirement: Run Test_AudioBaker and Test_AudioManager for WAV/Ogg baking, passthrough, invalid inputs, panning, placed playback, live updates, handle expiry, and mixer output.
validation_rules.rationale: These suites execute the codec and callback contract directly; a visible client is still required to prove a real platform device and audible output.

validation_rules.name: Visible audible validation
validation_rules.requirement: On every claimed platform, use a visible client with audio enabled to play baked WAV-path and native-Ogg-path resources, move a placed sound, replace music, exercise delayed and immediate repeats, and test volume endpoints.
validation_rules.rationale: Only an active platform audio device can prove conversion, callback scheduling, mixing, and audible output.

validation_rules.name: Embedding-project ownership
validation_rules.requirement: Keep catalog conventions, spatial/recipient policy, mastering, licenses, attribution, budgets, and gameplay triggers in project documentation and tests.
validation_rules.rationale: The engine supplies baking, runtime decoding, a client mixer, and placement parameters, not a complete game audio design or asset-governance system.
